---
title: Add activity history, records export & certificate integration
labels: enhancement, backend
---

Allow students to view their activity history and export records; integrate with certificate generation.

Description
- Provide per-student activity history endpoint and UI view.
- Allow export of student activity records as CSV or PDF.
- Link exported records to certificate generation workflows (reference existing `001-certificate-generation`).

Acceptance criteria
- Students can retrieve their activity history via API.
- Admins can export records for a student or an event.
- Automated tests for export functionality.

Notes
- Coordinate with certificate generation issue and admin dashboard.
